findings.claim: The MCP `exec-events` tool can return an unbounded event list, violating the bounded deterministic MCP results requirement.
findings.evidence: The execution-mcp-surface spec says “MCP tool schemas, success payloads, error envelopes, event pages, and artifact responses SHALL be deterministic, size-bounded,” but `ExecEventsParams` contains only `run_id` and `after`, and the handler returns `success(events)` from `facade.events_after(params.run_id, params.after)` with no page size, byte ceiling, or truncation cursor.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit page/byte limit to `ExecEventsParams`, enforce a hard maximum in the facade or MCP handler, and return a continuation cursor when more events remain.
